query:
SELECT id FROM pages
                WHERE indexed = FALSE
                    AND updated_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => $1)
                    AND (last_index_attempt_at IS NULL
                       OR last_index_attempt_at < NOW() - make_interval(secs => $1))
                    AND index_attempts < $3
                ORDER BY updated_at ASC
                LIMIT $2
